html:
Remote Web Design Services $0 / Month

You can build a new website with Everbuilt Studio and own all code, content, and domain. Hosting costs $0 / month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

How It Works

  1. Free homepage remake – no call, no payment details. If you don’t like it, keep your current design.
  2. Choose a launch package – $2,950 gives you a custom design, up to 5 pages, contact forms, and basic SEO.
  3. Pay 50 % upfront – the rest is due at launch.
  4. Enjoy 90 days of free care – after that you can pick a care plan at $295 / month or $595 / month, cancel anytime.
  5. Own the site – you control all code, content, and domain.

Packages

  • Launch – $2,950, up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, SEO basics.
  • Signature – $7,500, unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, spreadsheet events, email and form integrations.
  • Platform – $15 K, web apps, SaaS MVPs, mobile apps.

Hosting & Care

  • Hosting – $0 / month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • Care – 90 days free after launch; then $295 / month or $595 / month, cancel anytime.
  • Deposit – 50 % before work starts.
  • Downtime – 0 minutes during launch.

FAQ

Do I need to pay for hosting? No. Hosting is $0 / month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

Can I keep my current website if I don’t like the remake? Yes. If you don’t like the free homepage remake, you keep your existing design.

What happens after the 90 days of free care? You can choose a care plan at $295 / month or $595 / month, cancel any time.

Next Step

Start your free homepage remake now and take the first step toward a new website you own outright.
